summary.target: Local production build; canonical https://asia-trade-car.ru inferred from repository
summary.verdict: Critical first-audit issues are fixed; run live robots, sitemap, TLS and DB smoke checks before production indexation.
top_findings: Pricing promises conflict with preliminary-price and separate-expense disclaimers
Sitemap can exceed 50000 URLs near the SQL inventory limit
Arbitrary page=N catalog URLs can return indexable empty 200 pages
Sitemap silently drops vehicle URLs when the database is unavailable
Vehicle evidence, reviews and team expertise remain partly unverifiable

findings.title: Silent empty vehicle sitemap on DB failure
Thin vehicle evidence and weak review attribution
Dynamic no-store catalogs and 2.07 MiB autoplay video
15px mobile form controls, contrast and field error gaps
Missing BreadcrumbList/WebSite and incomplete social metadata
Trailing-slash SITE_URL and inherited home canonicals on noindex pages

limitations: Live deployment, DNS, TLS, CDN and production environment were not verified
No Search Console, GA4, Lighthouse or CrUX field data
Backlink score withheld because 0 of 7 required factors were available
